item.title: Josh Homme Sings AC/DC’s “Night Prowler” At Dean Delray’s Bon Scott Tribute Show
item.description: Comedian, podcaster, and musician Dean Delray celebrated his 60th birthday Tuesday by throwing a massive Bon Scott tribute concert at the Avalon in Hollywood. Delray has previously fronted a Bon Scott tribute band featuring the Black Crowes' Steve Gorman, Jetboy's Billy Rowe, Alice In Chains' Mike Inez, and Protein's Josh Zee, all of whom were on hand for this event. item.title: Record Store Day 2026 Exclusives Include Previously Unreleased Music From Weezer, Slipknot, Carly Rae Jepsen, & Ween
item.description: Record Store Day 2026 goes down on April 18, and today the list of exclusive titles has been announced. item.title: Alex Honnold Shares Tool-Heavy Taipei 101 Playlist, Maynard James Keenan Reacts To His Climb
item.description: Last month, famous rock climber Alex Honnold scaled the Taipei 101 skyscraper in Taiwan without any ropes or equipment. It was the highest free solo climb of an urban structure in history (1,667 ft) and it was livestreamed on Netflix. It was noted that he was listening to a lot of Tool during the ascent, and now he's shared the playlist he was streaming.
